name: sqs
description: Welcome to the Amazon SQS API Reference.

subcommands.name: add-permission
subcommands.description: Adds a permission to a queue for a specific principal.

subcommands.name: cancel-message-move-task
subcommands.description: Cancels a specified message movement task.

subcommands.name: change-message-visibility
subcommands.description: Changes the visibility timeout of a specified message in a queue to a new value.

subcommands.name: change-message-visibility-batch
subcommands.description: Changes the visibility timeout of multiple messages.

subcommands.name: create-queue
subcommands.description: Creates a new standard or FIFO queue.

subcommands.name: delete-message
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified message from the specified queue.

subcommands.name: delete-message-batch
subcommands.description: Deletes up to ten messages from the specified queue.

subcommands.name: delete-queue
subcommands.description: Deletes the queue specified by the QueueUrl, regardless of the queue's contents.

subcommands.name: get-queue-attributes
subcommands.description: Gets attributes for the specified queue.

subcommands.name: get-queue-url
subcommands.description: The GetQueueUrl API returns the URL of an existing Amazon SQS queue.

subcommands.name: list-dead-letter-source-queues
subcommands.description: Returns a list of your queues that have the RedrivePolicy queue attribute configured with a dead-letter queue.

subcommands.name: list-message-move-tasks
subcommands.description: Gets the most recent message movement tasks (up to 10) under a specific source queue.

subcommands.name: list-queue-tags
subcommands.description: List all cost allocation tags added to the specified Amazon SQS queue.

subcommands.name: list-queues
subcommands.description: Returns a list of your queues in the current region.

subcommands.name: purge-queue
subcommands.description: Deletes available messages in a queue (including in-flight messages) specified by the QueueURL parameter.

subcommands.name: receive-message
subcommands.description: Retrieves one or more messages (up to 10), from the specified queue.

subcommands.name: remove-permission
subcommands.description: Revokes any permissions in the queue policy that matches the specified Label parameter.

subcommands.name: send-message
subcommands.description: Delivers a message to the specified queue.

subcommands.name: send-message-batch
subcommands.description: You can use SendMessageBatch to send up to 10 messages to the specified queue by assigning either identical or different values to each message (or by not assigning values at all).

subcommands.name: set-queue-attributes
subcommands.description: Sets the value of one or more queue attributes, like a policy.

subcommands.name: start-message-move-task
subcommands.description: Starts an asynchronous task to move messages from a specified source queue to a specified destination queue.

subcommands.name: tag-queue
subcommands.description: Add cost allocation tags to the specified Amazon SQS queue.

subcommands.name: untag-queue
subcommands.description: Remove cost allocation tags from the specified Amazon SQS queue.
